notes.title: Patch Notes: March 30
notes.content:
Another patch with lots of requested features! I've been hard at work the past few weeks implementing some of the most highly requested features like Cloud Saves and Windowed Mode, and now those features are here! 

All the changes today, just like the last patch, are for Windows only. The Mac version of these changes are still a work in progress.

Added cloud saves.
Added windowed support, window resizing, and fullscreen toggling.
Fixed some typos and added some flavor text and overworld objects.
Added a dozen Easter Eggs referencing other videogames.
Added a barrier in the church to move one Spell later and make it have more utility.
Changed the plant names in the museum to not contain duplicates. 
Added an ingame prize for beating the game.
Gave more utility to a postgame Spell.
Added a feature that tells you what Spells you didn't encounter after you beat the game, in case you have missed any.
Added more catharsis in the ending cutscene.
Fixed picking up a flower when you had 0 of that flower always generating the New Flower text. (It will still happen once on your save file before it fixes itself.)
Changed the Sakuya's vase achievement to require not having the final flower (which it used to always require before the last patch.)

notes.title: Patch Notes: March 16
notes.content:
Big patch!

It's been a few months since the last patch, again, and that's because I was trying to implement some big changes. Adding windowed support, getting achievements working on Mac, and cloud saves are all still coming down the pipeline, and while none of those highly requested features are in this patch, again, I did finish what were by far the two most requested features, infinite undo, and making the game easier!

In much of my user testing, I noticed many players were getting stuck on the same set of Spells, usually at the very end. Finally I've gone and decided on a design philosophy for those parts of the game that I hope should make it a lot more reasonable. As well, infinite undo was a huge undertaking, but is finally done! Now you'll be able to tinker around with ideas you have in the game, instead of having to keep them in your mind. Patch notes:

Added ability to undo infinitely. (By far the most requested feature.)
Made the hint NPC be clearer in the lategame concerning what to focus on.
Fixed some typos and added/edited some more flavor text.
Fixed a glitch where you could get some museum ranks earlier than intended.
Added some hints to particularly difficult midgame Spells many people got stuck on.
Made the endgame more forgiving in what you had to do to trigger it.
Made running speed persists across areas/loads.
Fixed a glitch where one NPC would disappear/say the wrong dialogue/be visible in an unintended spot.
Changed some text in two hidden Easter Eggs in the game to make them less confusing.
Made a couple of the final puzzles be optional.

Note: For now, this patch is for Windows only. Mac users will have to wait a little longer for their infinite undo and achievements and this easier version of the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes: July 20
notes.content:
Big patch!

It's been a few months since the last patch, and that's because I was trying to implement some big changes. Adding windowed support, getting achievements working on Mac, infinite undo, and cloud saves are all monstrous endeavors, and while none of those highly requested features are in this patch, this patch does have a lot of great QoL fixes:

Fixed the positioning of some quest markers.
Fixed a bug where a certain Spell would be encountered too early.
Made the map start at your character's position instead of the Town Hall.
Fixed a bug where sometimes you would talk to the wrong NPC if two NPCs were in speaking range to you.
Added an indicator to show which NPC you are talking to.
Fixed some misleading NPC text and typos.
Added some new flavor text to multiple NPCs.
Fixed a crash caused by minimizing the game window while the game is loading.
Fixed a bug where an NPC would sometimes say a Spell early, causing a potential sequence break.

notes.title: Patch Notes: March 10
notes.content:
Bigger patch this time.

Fixed some typos.
Made some NPC dialogue explaining some game mechanics/lore clearer.
Added quest markers to quest NPCs.
Fixed a bug preventing you from learning the final two spells in the game, bringing the total to 100. 
Removed some rocks/fences for easier movement in one area.
Moved when you learn one Spell to be much earlier.
Fixed a bug where some players would learn an unlearnable Spell near the end of the game.
Made one of the endgame Spells much harder.
Fixed a cutscene showing the wrong nameplate.
Made all cutscenes start automatically without player input.
Fixed a bug where players would unlock the Truly Innocent achievement without actually earning it.

notes.title: Patch Notes: March 2
notes.content:
A much smaller patch this time.

Changelog:

Fixed a bug with ALTER that prevented it from working on specific letters.
Fixed some typos in some NPC dialogue.
Changed when the game calculates screen-size to hopefully mitigate unintended effects concerning alt-tabbing between windows during transitions.

notes.title: Patch Notes: February 22
notes.content:
The first post-release patch for Flowereverie has gone live!

Changelog:

Fixed a crash that can happen at the very end of the game
Increased map speed
Fixed various typos and OoB glitches
Added nameplates for important chars
Changed some NPC dialogue and help text to make some mechanics clearer
